title: The NEXT STAGE Of The AI Supercycle...
description:
We're beyond the stage of the AI cycle where it's all about chips and infrastructure.

How are you preparing to capitalize on what's coming, that being the AI efficiency wave?

#investing #ai #efficiency #chriscamillo
transcript: I have moved beyond this stage of the AI cycle where it's all about chips and infrastructure. I'm already thinking about the next stage of the cycle, which I call the AI efficiency wave, which is essentially the movement of companies that are making the picks and shovels to the companies that are optimally utilizing the picks and shovels of AI to become meaningfully more productive and efficient in their business. That is going to provide an opportunity to have a much broader array of companies that will benefit from AI as opposed to where we have been the last year, where it's the same 10 or 20 companies we're talking about every week. Because if you think about it, just about every single company that has a high cost structure stands to meaningfully benefit from the efficiency that AI will ultimately bring. I think it plays out over the next 1 to 3 years, and I think as soon as the market sees it start to play out, they will adjust earnings, adjust multiples of all the companies that are benefiting as soon as they start to see it play out in earnings.
